origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 为 (to do, make) as sound and meaning: something made by people, artificial, so false. Simplified from 偽 by writing 為 as 为.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound, the jaws closing on each other: to bite. It also replaces the old form 齩.

奉.def: to offer, to respect, to server; to receive

origin.says: First 丰 (lush plant) as the sound over 廾 (two hands): to hold up, to offer. A 手 (hand) was later added below, and the parts ran together into the modern shape.

奉.name: present

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 贞 (to divine, inquire) as the sound and meaning: a person who inquires, to spy, to detect.

谅.def: to excuse, to forgive; to guess, to presume

origin.says: Simplified from 諒: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 京 (capital) as the sound: trust in someone's word, to understand and forgive. 言 (speech) is written in its short form 讠.

谅.name: forgive

扣.def: to detain; to knock, to tap; button

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 口 (mouth) as the sound: to hold back, to knock, to fasten; it also took over 釦 (button).

扣.name: button

侧.def: side; to slant, to lean, to incline

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 則 (rule) as the sound: the side of a person, to lean. Simplified from 側 by writing 貝 as 贝.

侧.name: side

恋.def: love; to yearn for, to long for

origin.says: Simplified from 戀: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 䜌 (tangled threads) as the sound; the complex 䜌 was written in cursive as 亦 (also), which gives no sound: to long for, love.

恋.name: longing love

炒.def: to boil, to fry, to roast, to sauté; to trade stock

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 少 (few) as the sound: to stir-fry over fire.

炒.name: stir-fry

晒.def: to dry in the sun; to expose to the sun

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 西 (west) as the sound: to dry in the sun. It replaces 曬, whose sound part was 麗 (beautiful).

晒.name: dry in sun

ety.hint: Like a sheet 页 of stone 石

origin.says: Simplified from 碩: 石 (stone) as the sound plus 頁 (head) for the meaning: a big head, hence great or large. 頁 is simplified to 页.

扯.def: to rip, to tear; to haul; casual talk

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 止 (stop) as the sound: to pull, to tear. It replaced an older form 撦, whose sound part was 奢 (lavish).

扯.name: tug

ety.hint: A tiger 虍 baring its claws 彐

origin.says: In oracle bones 虎 (tiger) about to eat 人 (person): cruel, tyrannical. Only the tiger top 虍 survives clearly; the lower part changed into a claw-like shape.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 倉; grains 食 kept in storage 口

origin.says: 倉 pictured a granary: a roof, a door 戶 (door) and a storage pit 口 (mouth). The simplified form is a cursive outline that looks like 人 (person) over 㔾 (kneeling person).
讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 牙 (tooth) as the sound: to exclaim, be surprised. Simplified from 訝, 言 (speech) shortened to 讠.

崩.def: to rupture, to split apart; to collapse; death, demise

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 朋 (friend) as the sound: a mountain collapsing.

崩.name: collapse

瞒.def: to deceive, to lie; to regard with suspicion

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 㒼 (to cover tightly) as sound and meaning: covering someone's eyes, to hide the truth. Simplified from 瞞, the sound part shortened to 艹 over 两.

瞒.name: hide truth

origin.says: A late character from 卓 (tall) as sound and meaning plus 木 (wood): a raised wooden table. 木 took the place of the bottom 十 of 卓, so only the top of 卓 is left over 木.
果 (fruit) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: a small round head-like thing, a grain, a bead; now a counter for small round objects. One source swaps the roles.
犭 (animal) for the meaning plus 师 (teacher) as the sound: the lion, an animal known in China through gifts from Central Asia. Simplified from 獅 along with 师.

ety.hint: A mouse, with two paws to the left and the tail to the right

origin.says: A picture of a rat: the top like 臼 (mortar) is the open mouth with teeth, the bottom the feet and the long tail.
Simplified from 幟: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 戠 as the sound: a flag, a banner. 戠 was replaced by 只 (only).
Simplified from 壽, whose top is a remnant of 老 (old) and whose lower part was a sound part with decorations, the hand becoming 寸 (inch). The short form keeps only an outline: long life, lifespan.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 夷 (barbarians) as the sound: a mother's sister, aunt.

ety.hint: An empty 干 fishing net ⺳; 干 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 㓁 (net) for the meaning plus 干 (shield) as the sound: originally a kind of net; the word came to mean rare, scarce.

薄.def: thin, slight; meager, weak; poor, stingy

origin.says: 艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 溥 (vast) as the sound: first dense thin growth, then thin, slight, meagre.

薄.name: thin

ety.hint: The color of the sap 一 of some trees 木

origin.says: 木 (tree) with a mark across its middle, pointing to the trunk's core (later written 株). The meaning 'vermilion, red' is a sound loan; the traditional 硃 for cinnabar is written 朱 again.
Simplified from 脹: 月 (here flesh, body) for the meaning plus 长 (long, grow) as the sound: the body swelling up.

迈.def: old; to pass by, to take a stride

ety.hint: To take ten thousand 万 steps 辶

origin.says: Simplified from 邁: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 萬 (ten thousand) as the sound: to stride forward. 萬 is simplified to 万.

迈.name: stride

origin.says: 宀 (house) for the meaning plus 叔 (uncle) as the sound: a house with no one in it, still, silent, lonely.

ety.hint: An old serving dish 口 on a stand with a lid 一

origin.says: A drawing of a tall food bowl on a stand, sometimes with a lid. It was borrowed for 'bean', whose older character was 菽, because the words sounded alike.

豆.name: bean
豆.in: 喜短登鼓厨膨嘉澄逗橙瞪壹凳橱蹬嘻彭痘豌澎

窝.def: cave, den, nest; hiding place; measure word for small animals

origin.says: 穴 (cave) for the meaning plus 咼 (crooked mouth) as the sound: a den or nest. Simplified from 窩 with 呙.

窝.name: nest

origin.says: 虫 (insect, creature) for the meaning plus 它 (once a drawing of a snake) as the sound: snake. 它 itself was the original character for snake before it was borrowed for 'it'.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 析 (split) as the sound: clear as daylight.

魅.def: magic, enchantment, charm; a forest demon

ety.hint: A forest 未 demon 鬼; 未 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 鬼 (ghost, spirit) for the meaning plus 未 (not yet) as the sound: a goblin of the woods, and the bewitching power such spirits have, charm.

魅.name: enchant

喔.def: onomatopoetic, the sound of crowing or crying

冻.def: cold; to freeze, to congeal; jelly

origin.says: Simplified from 凍: 冫 (ice) for the meaning plus 東 (east) as the sound, now 东: to freeze.

冻.name: freeze

ety.hint: A corpse 死 laid 廾 to rest under the grass 艹

origin.says: A 死 (dead person) between grass above and below: burying the dead in the grass. The top is now 艹 and the lower grass became 廾 (two hands).
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 囷 (round granary) as the sound: a mushroom, now also germs and bacteria.

悬.def: to hang, to hoist, to suspend; hung

ety.hint: Pride 心  in one's country 县, expressed by a flag; 县 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 懸: 縣 (hang) as the sound and first meaning, plus 心 (heart) added once 縣 meant 'county': to hang, suspended. The simplified form uses 县 (county).

悬.name: suspend

ety.hint: A shell discarded 冗 by a soldier 士

origin.says: Simplified from 殼, whose left part (now 士 over 冖 and 几) stood for the shell and 殳 (striking hand) was dropped. How the left part was built is unclear.
From 恥: 耳 (ear) as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning, shame felt inside. A popular variant swapped 心 for 止 (stop), and it became the simplified form.

趁.def: to take advantage of, to seize an opportunity

origin.says: 走 (run) for the meaning plus 㐱 (thick hair) as the sound: first to follow, to chase, now to seize a chance while it lasts.

趁.name: seize chance

炼.def: to smelt, to refine; to distill, to condense

origin.says: Simplified from 煉: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 柬 (pick out) as the sound, 柬 written in a cursive short form: purifying metal in the fire, to smelt and refine.

炼.name: smelt

贩.def: merchant, peddler; to deal in, to trade

origin.says: Simplified from 販: 貝 (cowry shell, money) for the meaning plus 反 (reverse) as the sound: to buy and sell again, to peddle. 貝 became 贝.

贩.name: peddler

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 危 (danger) as the sound; 危 also happens to show a kneeling person: to kneel.

榜.def: placard, notice, announcement; a list of names

ety.hint: A sign posted 旁 on a tree 木; 旁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 旁 (beside) as the sound: a wooden board, then a notice board, a list of names.

榜.name: notice board

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 莫 (do not) as the sound: a desert, a place without water, and so 'cold, indifferent'.

汰.def: to eliminate, to scour, to wash out; excessive

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 太 (too) as the sound: to wash and sift, to weed out.

汰.name: wash out

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound, used for 'all, the various'. Simplified from 諸, with 言 written 讠.

砸.def: to smash, to pound, to crush, to break

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 匝 (to go round) as the sound: to smash with a stone, to pound.

砸.name: pound

origin.says: 王 (jade) for the meaning plus 耑 (sprout, tip) as the sound: a jade token given as a sign of rank or good fortune: auspicious.

壮.def: big, large; robust, strong; the name of a tribe

origin.says: Simplified from 壯: 士 (man, soldier) for the meaning plus 爿 (plank) as the sound, now written ⺦: a strong, sturdy man.

壮.name: sturdy

捉.def: to clutch, to grasp, to seize

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 足 (foot) as the sound: to grasp, to catch hold of.

捉.name: clutch

牵.def: to drag, to pull, to lead by the hand

ety.hint: A person 大 pulling an ox 牛 by a rope 冖

origin.says: Simplified from 牽: 牛 (ox) for the meaning, 冖 a rope or yoke, and 玄 (dark) on top as the sound: leading an ox by a rope. In the simplified form the top 玄 became 大.

牵.name: lead by rope

origin.says: 夃 (unclear part) over 皿 (vessel): a vessel that is full, overflowing. The meaning of the top part is uncertain.
Simplified from 霧: 雨 (rain, weather) for the meaning plus 務 (task) as the sound, now the shortened 务: fog and mist.
Simplified from 暢: 申 (to stretch, extend) for the meaning plus 昜 (sunlit) as the sound: unobstructed, flowing freely. 昜 is written in its cursive shape 𠃓.

匹.def: bolt of cloth; mate, one of a pair; measure word for horses

origin.says: Origin uncertain: one reading sees folds of a roll of cloth; others see a stone part with a sound part, or half of a pair of horses. Now a bolt of cloth, a match, and the counter for horses.

匹.name: bolt of cloth

ety.hint: Wine 酉 aged too long 夋; 夋 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 夋 (a walking figure) as the sound: the sour taste of wine turned to vinegar.

莱.def: weed, goosefoot; fallow field; used in transliterations

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 来 (come) as the sound: goosefoot, a weed, and fallow land; now often for foreign sounds. Simplified from 萊.

莱.name: goosefoot

擎.def: to lift; to support, to hold up

origin.says: 敬 (revere) as the sound plus 手 (hand) for the meaning: to lift up and hold aloft.

擎.name: hold aloft

嫁.def: to marry, to give a daughter in marriage

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 家 (home) as the sound and hint: a woman going to her new home, to marry.

嫁.name: marry off

悔.def: to regret, to repent, to show remorse

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound: to regret, to repent.

悔.name: repent

扔.def: to throw, to hurl, to cast away

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 乃 (and then) as the sound: to throw with the hand, to throw away.

扔.name: toss

巩.def: to bind, to guard, to strengthen; firm, secure, strong

origin.says: Simplified from 鞏 (bind with leather): 巩 (hold) as the sound plus 革 (leather) for the meaning; the short form drops 革 (leather). 巩 itself is 工 (work) for the sound with a holding hand, now looking like 凡 (ordinary).

巩.name: secure

尬.def: awkward, embarrassed; to limp, to stagger

origin.says: 尢 (a lame person) for the meaning plus 介 (go-between) as the sound: walking unsteadily, now 'awkward' in the word for embarrassment.

尬.name: awkward

origin.says: Simplified from 尷: 尢 (lame leg) for the meaning plus 監 (supervise) as the sound: walking awkwardly, embarrassed. It uses the simplified 监.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 疏 (sparse) as the sound: vegetables and greens.

拾.def: to collect, to pick up, to tidy up; ten (bankers' anti-fraud numeral)

ety.hint: To gather 合 things in one's hands 扌

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 合 (join) as the sound: to gather up by hand, pick up; also a formal way to write ten.

拾.name: pick up

砍.def: to hack, to chop, to cut, to fell

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 欠 (yawn) as the sound: to hack or chop, as with a stone blade.

砍.name: chop

origin.says: A modern chemistry character: 石 (stone, solid non-metal) plus 炭 (charcoal) for sound and meaning: the element carbon.

柱.def: to lean on; pillar, post, support

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 主 (master) as the sound: a wooden post or pillar.

柱.name: pillar

ety.hint: Water 水 flowing from a spring 白

origin.says: A drawing of water 水 (water) flowing out of the mouth of a spring, the top drawn like 白 (white) but unrelated to it: a spring; old coins were also called by this name.

ety.hint: A cycle 勹 of ten days 日; a traditional week

origin.says: A picture of an earthworm, borrowed for its sound to mean a ten-day period; 日 (sun, day) was added. The worm shape was later mistaken for 勹 (wrap).
辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 折 (break) as the sound: to go away, to pass away.

喷.def: to blow, to puff, to spray, to spurt

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 贲 (bright, ornate) as the sound: to spurt from the mouth, to spray. Simplified from 噴.

喷.name: spurt
